name: Paltel Group Al-Bireh Tier III Data Center (second Paltel data center)
notes: DCD reported Paltel Group launched its second data center, a 65,000 sq ft (~6,000 sq m) facility in Ramallah/Al-Bireh, central West Bank, Uptime Tier III Design certified (first in the country to receive an Uptime award), built at ~$10m for colocation, cloud-based disaster recovery and back-office services; opened at a ceremony with PM Mohammad Shtayyeh in late September 2019.

name: Zone Ramallah Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings (Data Center Catalog, Data Center Map) describe Zone Technologies' managed colocation data center at 3 Al Madaen Street, Masrouji Building, 1st floor, Ramallah, offering virtualization, managed hosting, backup and VPN-based services; Data Center Map lists it as one of the 1-2 facilities in Palestine.

name: MTIT government data center (Palestinian Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Technology)
developer: Palestinian Ministry of Telecommunications and Information Technology (MTIT)
notes: The World Bank Palestinian Digital Economy Assessment references the MTIT data center in Ramallah (ministry seat) and notes the absence of a disaster recovery site leaves it vulnerable; size/status not detailed, location inferred from MTIT headquarters in Ramallah.
